meta.title: Privacy statement · GinfinAI
meta.description: How GinfinAI handles the information you share through this website.

p: GinfinAI, Gerben Ceuppens, Notestraat 64, 1742 Ternat, Belgium, VAT BE1012.619.721. Send privacy questions to info@ginfinai.be.
Contact form: your name, email address, message and, if you fill them in, company, phone number, subject and budget. I only use them to reply to your request and, where relevant, prepare a quote.
Legal basis: steps taken at your request before a possible contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Messages that don't lead to an assignment are deleted no later than 12 months after the last contact. If you become a client, I keep the data as long as the law requires, for example for accounting.
Vercel (website hosting) and Resend (delivering the form to my mailbox). Standard contractual clauses apply to transfers outside the EU.
Website statistics: I measure the site's loading speed with Vercel Speed Insights. No cookies are set and no personal profiles are built.
You can always access, correct or delete your data, and object to its use. Email info@ginfinai.be; you will get a reply within one month.
If you are not satisfied, you can lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (www.dataprotectionauthority.be).
